---
title: "Volume IV"
subtitle: "Physical AI: Machine Learning Systems That Sense and Act"
---

Lecture decks for Volume IV, which covers machine learning systems that sense the physical world and act on it, where a learned output becomes a physical action that cannot be taken back. Every lecture comes as a PDF for projection, a PowerPoint file whose notes pane holds the speaker notes, and the LaTeX source.
